description: SOC-thermal Nernst + Arrhenius-R model for organic aqueous redox flow battery stack. Representative of AQDS/ferricyanide and TEMPO/viologen chemistry. Temperature range 10-40 degC.

unit.name: Generic 20-cell organic RFB stack, 100 cm2 electrode area
unit.source: Lin, K. et al. (2015). Science 349, 1529; Janoschka, T. et al. (2015). Nature 527, 78; Huskinson, B. et al. (2014). Nature 505, 195

E0.note: Representative standard cell potential for AQDS/ferricyanide couple (~0.7 V); TEMPO/viologen ~1.1 V. Using AQDS as reference.

R_cell_ohm_cm2_ref.note: Area-specific resistance at T_ref; organic RFBs typically 5-8 Ohm.cm2 due to larger molecule transport limitations

electrolyte_conc_M.note: Typical organic RFB concentration; solubility-limited relative to vanadium

pump_loss_coefficient.note: Pump parasitic: small stack, lower flow requirement

E_a.note: Activation energy for organic RFB resistance; slightly lower than VRFB due to smaller molecules but higher than EDLC. Representative value.
E_a.source: Huskinson et al. (2014) Nature 505, 195; Kwabi, D. G. et al. (2020) Chem. Rev. 120, 6467

dOCV_dT.note: Temperature coefficient of standard potential for quinone/ferricyanide couple. Quinone E0 temperature dependence dominated by proton-coupled electron transfer entropy. dE0/dT estimated -0.2 to -0.4 mV/K for AQDS-type quinones at pH 0.
dOCV_dT.source: Kwabi, D. G. et al. (2020) Chem. Rev. 120, 6467; Yang, Z. et al. (2011) Chem. Sus. Chem. 4, 1338

T_min.note: 10 degC lower limit (electrolyte viscosity, limited kinetics)

T_max.note: 40 degC upper limit (molecular degradation of organic active species above ~40-50 degC)
